integrity.mathematical_scope: All integers m >= 3, all B > 0, all c > 0; critical scaling for fixed real kappa as m tends to infinity.
integrity.review: Same-model scientific review only; external audit not performed.
integrity.verification: Standard-library exact-rational verifier plus analytic proof; no infinite proof is inferred from tests.

scientific_limitations: The exact allocation theorem applies to wheel graphs with two dihedrally invariant conductance-price classes, not arbitrary per-edge prices.
The inner-regime conductance ratio is given by a unique scalar root rather than an elementary closed expression.
Computational checks are finite and only supplement analytic all-size proofs.
Earlier general wheel optimization and its spectral reduction were known; no novelty is claimed for those ingredients.
Unindexed earlier price-sensitive wheel results may exist; independent priority assessment was not performed.

A shorter 2006 public conference version of the foundational framework exists, but its exact public-release day was not established; the 2008-01-22 date is the earliest fully day-verified focal source inspected.
title: A sharp rim-price threshold and critical scaling for resistance-optimal wheel networks
